name: Rainforests of the Atsinanana
description: Strung along Madagascar's eastern side, this World Heritage Site links six national parks, including Marojejy, Masoala and Ranomafana, that protect the last remnants of the island's old rainforest. Madagascar broke away from other landmasses over 60 million years ago, so its plants and animals evolved alone. Visitors come above all to hear and spot rare lemurs in the misty canopy.
